gameContentText: Rules text and data (spells, classes, species, backgrounds, feats, items) come from the 2014 D&D books through the 5etools data files. The content belongs to Wizards of the Coast.
graphicsDdb: The default character portraits, item icons, sheet frames and several interface icons are D&D Beyond / Wizards of the Coast art. The dice icons are Font Awesome icons as served by D&D Beyond. The layout takes inspiration from the D&D Beyond character sheet and builder.
